structural_comparison.axis_convention: viewer-left to viewer-right eye midpoint; positive height is clockwise perpendicular in stored-raster xy
structural_comparison.normalization: each source's own uncertain reference eye span; eye-width asymmetry uses sum of eye widths
structural_comparison.meaning: projected configuration under image pose and expression; dependent measurements, not identity probability or physical depth
structural_comparison.bounds_meaning: analytic outer intervals from the existing shared reference-error sets; no refit, new alignment or independent votes
structural_comparison.missingness: all fourteen measurements remain; false array masks mark zero sentinels

regional_comparison.direction: B minus A in the existing canonical chart; x viewer-right, y image-down
regional_comparison.deformation_direction: existing A-to-B piecewise-affine map, uniformly weighted supported A-domain pixels
regional_comparison.shear_definition: off-diagonal entry of log(U) in the canonical chart, not engineering shear or an axis-invariant scalar
regional_comparison.fraction_bounds_meaning: missingness range over the declared landmark inventory, not a confidence interval
regional_comparison.meaning: observed projected model geometry, not physical strain or independent anatomical validation
regional_comparison.missingness: all seven regions retained; zero array sentinels require the associated support mask

edge_comparison.sign: B minus A along the anchor contour normal (-tangent_y, tangent_x)
edge_comparison.rejection_order: first failing rule per side; counts partition the ray inventory
edge_comparison.range_meaning: fixed-ray missingness range, not a confidence interval or resemblance probability
limits: Landmark-guided gradients are image evidence, not independently labeled anatomical contours
A-anchored and B-anchored rays are separate dependent inventories; do not pool them
Normal displacement omits tangential motion; competing texture edges may differ in anatomical identity
A missing edge or a peak outside the finite search window remains unresolved
No landmark movement, extra alignment, fitted correspondence or reference confidence is introduced

sensitivity.incomplete_experiment_rule: retain all slots; withhold intervals; no successful-draw-only quantiles

percentage_meaning: fraction of a prespecified, dependent relation inventory within explicit tolerances; NOT a probability of resemblance
limits: 2D projected geometry, not identity recognition or proof of 3D shape
model contours and interpolated fields derive from the same landmarks; not independent evidence
sensitivity intervals are conditional perturbation intervals, not measured localization-accuracy confidence intervals
flow consistency tests image matching, not anatomical correctness across people
within-tolerance fractions have an explicit threshold and denominator; they are not resemblance probabilities
no population rarity without an exact-recipe held-out reference cohort
the report contains new tool-side evidence, not inaccessible historical model activations
